policies.title: DPRK ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule expressly places Democratic People's Republic of Korea passports in its Prior to Arrival cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Democratic People's Republic of Korea passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

DPRK exit permission, carrier service, sanctions compliance, route availability, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside this classification.

policies.title: DPRK ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table explicitly says a North Korean visitor visa can be obtained on arrival.
conditions: Applies only to an ordinary Democratic People's Republic of Korea passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The table says the arrival visa costs 40 JOD and all non-Jordanians must obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
DPRK exit permission, carrier service, sanctions compliance, border-route availability, work, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
